root_cause.text: The function `ublk_ctrl_uring_cmd()` calls `ublk_ctrl_cmd_dump()` before checking the `IO_URING_F_SQE128` flag, allowing access to the `cmd` field of the SQE which may be out-of-bounds if the flag is not set (SQE size is only 64 bytes instead of 128 bytes).
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that `ublk_ctrl_cmd_dump(cmd);` was originally placed before the `if (!(issue_flags & IO_URING_F_SQE128))` check. The fix moves the flag check earlier and returns `-EINVAL` immediately if the flag is not set, preventing the out-of-bound access in `ublk_ctrl_cmd_dump()`.
